documents.text: Refund policy: customers may request a full refund within 30 days of purchase if the product is unused and in original packaging.
Standard shipping takes 5 business days to the continental US. Express shipping arrives in 2 business days.
API keys must never be committed to git. Rotate keys every 90 days and store secrets in a vault.
